summary: Vail Mountain Rescue Group volunteers Erika German and Zach Smith found belongings and remains of hiker Michelle Vanek (missing since September 2005) above the boulder field on the north/northeast side of Mt. of the Holy Cross; the sheriff's October 2024 recovery confirmed her identity, closing a 19-year case.
location: Mt. of the Holy Cross, north/northeast side above the boulder field
responding_agency: Vail Mountain Rescue Group; Eagle County Sheriff's Office
notes: Subject Michelle Vanek, 35, of Lakewood went missing 2005-09-24 (outside the 2010 floor); this row dates the documented 2024-09-13 discovery mission per the id-2193 cold-case-recovery precedent. Forensic anthropologist: spinal fracture consistent with a fall; no foul play. MERGE run 875: ECSO press release on the 2024-09-13 find of Vanek personal items (parent-opened realvail a19998).
